name: 20008 · Washington, DC
findings: ZIP 20008 (Washington) has 329 nonprofit organizations. 155 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 130 organizations.
Research and think tank organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 20008 (Washington) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Research and think tank organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 18 research and think tank organizations here list membership, compared with about 7 in similar places of this size.
